bifrost: springboard/src/media/hwdec/ (libavcodec + VA-API decode), springboard/src/media/convert.rs (NV12 to RGBA), springboard/src/gpu/nv12.rs (NV12 dma-buf import), springboard/src/shell/video.rs (consumer)
summary: BifrOSt decodes H.264 and HEVC in hardware (VA-API through libavcodec, software fallback) and converts NV12 to RGBA for the shell, but only inside the media stack. No app-facing SDK API exists, and there is no compression session, encoder, pixel transfer, rotation, RAW, HDR metadata or frame processing.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/hwdec/ffmpeg.rs (Decoder, impl VideoDecoder), springboard/src/media/mod.rs (VideoDecoder trait, line 226); springboard/sdk/src/video_decompression.rs (DecompressionSession, FormatDescription)
features.note: The app-facing session, format check and output handler are tested headless: parameter sets go in front of the first sample and after a flush, and pictures arrive in order. Gap: H.264 and HEVC only, and the libavcodec decoder itself has not run on the lab machine.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/hwdec/vaapi.rs (libva probe on the DRM render node); springboard/sdk/src/video_decompression.rs (hardware_decode_supported, support_from_probe, can_accept)
features.note: The per-codec answer of the probe is exposed to apps and checked by can_accept, tested headless with probe data. Gap: the probe itself has not been read on the lab machine, and the query covers the codec set only, not profiles or levels.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/mod.rs (Pixels::Dma, DmaPicture), springboard/src/gpu/nv12.rs (EGL dma-buf import); springboard/sdk/src/video_decompression.rs (DecodedPixels::Buffer, set_zero_copy)
features.note: With zero-copy requested, a decoded picture reaches an app as its dma-buf handle (DecodedPixels::Buffer), tested headless. Gap: the handle is a Linux dma-buf, the GPU import is not exposed to apps, and the path has not run on the lab machine.

features.apple: VTCompressionSessionCreate, VTCompressionSessionEncodeFrame, output callback, PrepareToEncodeFrames, CompleteFrames
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Midget check pending. Lossless intra-only (one PNG per frame, springboard::pngenc); H.264/HEVC encoders do not exist and fail with CouldNotFindVideoEncoder; no frame reordering.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (theme-16, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. depends on the encode gap

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (theme-16, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. libavcodec options are set internally in ffmpeg.rs with no property API
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Midget check pending. Storage records encoded sizes only; two passes; no rate control uses them yet.

Pure model with headless tests: NV12 and I420 pictures convert to RGBA and scale by nearest neighbour, and RGBA scales too. Gap: not wired into apps or the shell, no app-facing pixel transfer session, and no test on the VM or Midget.

Quarter turns with mirrors, and clockwise angles that map to a turn (turn_for_degrees), are tested headless. Gap: not wired into apps or the shell, and the rotation is not exposed as a video-buffer rotation session, nor tested on the VM or Midget.

The Bayer tiles, the demosaic at frame edges, white balance and refusal of bad frames are tested headless in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01.rs. Gap: no camera-native or RAW container path in springboard/src/media, and v4l2.rs converts only the YUV formats it lists.

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/hdr_metadata.rs (FrameLightSession, code_to_nits; PQ and HLG transfers)
features.note: The PQ and HLG light model, the per-frame peak and mean and the scene peak over 10-bit codes are tested headless in render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs. Gaps: the model is not attached to decoded frames, the decoder path is 8-bit NV12 only, and nothing is run on the VM or Midget.

features.feature: Frame processing (super resolution, frame interpolation, optical flow, noise filter, motion blur)
features.apple: VTFrameProcessor, VTSuperResolutionScalerConfiguration, VTFrameRateConversionConfiguration, VTMotionBlurConfiguration, VTOpticalFlowConfiguration, VTTemporalNoiseFilterConfiguration
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Midget check pending. Only nearest-neighbour super resolution; no frame interpolation, optical flow, noise filter or motion blur.

Full-search block motion between 8-bit planes (SAD per block, clipped edge blocks, zero offset first on ties) is tested headless in render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-30.rs. Gap: not wired into a decoder, the shell or apps, and there is no sub-pixel or hierarchical search; not yet verified on the VM or Midget.
NV12 pictures convert and scale to the shell's own gfx::Image pixels, tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs. Gap: the output is not a CGImage.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/hwdec/ffmpeg.rs (libavcodec dlopen, codec set fixed to H.264 and HEVC); springboard/sdk/src/video_decompression.rs (codec_for_sample_entry, is_decodable)
features.note: Sample-entry codes map to the fixed codec set, and VP9 and AV1 are refused, tested headless. Gap: the codec set is compiled into the media stack (springboard/src/media/mod.rs line 101), so no extension can register a decoder.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 4 tests. errors surface as io::Error, not VT status codes

Pixel transfer and rotation as SDK sessions for app pixel buffers
